title: where a random sign's cost goes (aifoundry3 card 0, 600 MHz)
request: Q132, item 2 of the kinds page's section 11

plan.items_per_pass: the tie twice, E78's six anchors three times, E92's 32 tiles and fp32.ones, fp16.ones once

sign_bit_price_sources.fp16.B: docs/reports/data/2026-10-31-e79-fp16-int8-bit-prices/README.md table '### fp16, B side (A = 1.0), jg layout' row 15 (a bound)

fp32.h_add-c_abs.what: the sign bits: every B, product and C sign moves, the adder always adds

fp32.h_sub-h_add.what: the same operands: alternate add, subtract, against always add

fp32.c_alt-c_abs.what: no operand or product sign moves at k >= 1: only the sign the sum holds, so the adder alternates

fp32.h_allsub-h_add.what: the same operands: always subtract, against always add

fp32.c_neg-c_abs.what: nothing moves at k >= 1: always subtract, against always add

fp32.i_sub-i_add.what: the A-side twin: alternation every two micro-ops

fp32.s_abs-c_abs.what: random signs, frozen: E88's M32s on this card

fp32.r_h_sub-r_h_add.what: the core contrast on random positive magnitudes, frozen

fp32.w_h_sub-w_h_add.what: the core contrast with a moving sum, magnitude 1

fp32.wr_h_sub-wr_h_add.what: the core contrast with moving sums on random positive magnitudes
fp32.wr_h_sub-wr_h_add.e90_linear_source: (E90 randn - abs_randn 1.866 W, minus its bits 0.547 W) x N_alt(wr_h_sub) / N_alt(randn)

fp32.k_only-c_abs.what: the kinds page's design: operand signs flip at k boundaries only, every product +

fp32.w_h_add-w_c.what: the sign bits with a moving sum (E65's bit_31 layout)

fp32.w_h_sub-w_c.what: signs and alternation with a moving sum

fp32.r_h_add-r_abs.what: the sign bits on random magnitudes, frozen

fp32.r_h_sub-r_abs.what: signs and alternation on random magnitudes, frozen

fp32.wr_h_add-r_walk.what: the sign bits on random magnitudes, moving sums

fp16.signs-ones.what: E90's headline step in fp16, this session

E92-R1.what: the sign bits' price holds for h_add - c_abs (every operand, product and C sign moves; the adder always adds)
E92-R1.per_contrast: CONFIRMED if the 95% upper bound <= 2 x P_bits, REFUTED if the 95% lower bound > 2 x P_bits, else INCONCLUSIVE

E92-R2.what: the adder-alternation reading: same operands, or none moving; only the effective operation differs
E92-R2.per_contrast: CONFIRMED if the 95% interval lies inside [0.5, 2] x pred_w, REFUTED if it lies wholly below 0.25 x pred_w or wholly above 4 x pred_w, else INCONCLUSIVE

E92-R3.what: subtraction itself is not dear: a steady effective subtract costs what a steady add costs
E92-R3.per_contrast: CONFIRMED if the 95% interval lies inside +-0.50 W, REFUTED if wholly outside, else INCONCLUSIVE

E92-R4.what: the A-side twin: alternation every two micro-ops costs half (N_alt ratio from e92.json)
E92-R4.statistic: (i_sub - i_add) - (N_alt(i_sub) / N_alt(h_sub)) x (h_sub - h_add), paired per pass
E92-R4.per_contrast: CONFIRMED if the 95% interval lies inside +-band, REFUTED if wholly outside, else INCONCLUSIVE

E92-R5.what: linear in the number of lanes alternating
E92-R5.statistic: for m = 2, 4, 6: (h_sub<m> - c_abs) - (m / 8) x (h_sub - c_abs), paired per pass
E92-R5.per_contrast: each rung as R4; CONFIRMED if all three are, REFUTED if any is, else INCONCLUSIVE

E92-R6.what: random signs at about 50% alternation are the same price per alternation as structured signs at 100%
E92-R6.statistic: (s_abs - c_abs - P_bits(s_abs)) - (N_alt(s_abs) / N_alt(h_sub)) x (h_sub - c_abs - P_bits(h_sub)), paired per pass; fp32, fp16

E92-R7.what: with the product absorbed its magnitude does not matter

E92-R8.what: with moving sums the alternation's price follows the adder's flops (e88+flops)

E92-R9.what: a few hundred operand sign flips an op, every product positive: nothing to measure

E92-R10.what: fp16's two aligners: the 52-bit one costs more than the 29-bit one
E92-R10.per_contrast: CONFIRMED if the 95% lower bound >= 0.5 x pred_w, REFUTED if the 95% upper bound < 0, else INCONCLUSIVE

E92-S1.what: the session tie to E78 and to E90 (reported; a failure means the session moved)
E92-S1.rule: each cell's D within its band of E78's and of E90's; E90's own tiles of E90's

E92-S2.what: the frozen models, out of sample (reported)
E92-S2.rule: for every contrast: inside E88's band or not; rms of e88+flops over the contrasts with a rule; Q130(n)'s count of tiles inside its 95% interval

E92-S3.what: the tie to E88, across cards (reported)
E92-S3.rule: s_abs - c_abs within +-0.75 W of scale x M32s; c_abs - zeros within +-1.0 W of scale x F32

not_scored_if: fewer than 3 kept passes in the primary reduction: then every rule is scored on the registered dips-removed arm (E86's posthoc_dips method), labelled as that arm; fewer than 3 there too: NOT SCORED.
